what: Friction-grip model for the kinematic pads; Dream fleet batch passed 5 of 9 random 15-30 cm holds.
why: User asked for realistic side-grasp physics (slight squeeze, arm can still take the cup); probes showed the kinematic pads transfer almost no friction.
details: Grip forms only while both pads squeeze the same cup; drives the cup's velocity toward its held pose with gravity on, no attachment, releases on open/slip.
Zero-API probe: 9/9 carried. Batch 22: tables 1, 3, 7, 8, 9 held 20/16/29/19/21 cm for 5 s (video review pending).
Results are labelled friction-grip model; not a calibrated hardware grasp.
